```lean
constructor
· intro h
  intros s a hnotin
  have hsubset : s ⊆ insert a s := by simp [insert_subset]
  have hneq : s ≠ insert a s := by rintro rfl; exact hnotin
  exact h s a hnotin

· intro h
  intros s t hsub hneq
  have : ∃ a : α, a ∈ t \ s := by exact_mod_cast hneq
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := this
  have ht : t = insert a s := by rw [diff_eq_insert]; exact ⟨ha, hsub⟩
  exact h s a (by contraposition ht)
```
